messages:
Samira Patel: Heads-up — Acme POC inbound. They need a signed DPA + SCCs before we ingest any live customer data, plus a completed SIG/CAIQ and confirmation on DSAR deletion proofs. POC kickoff earliest Mon. Can we assemble answers and an evidence timeline? cc @Maria Gonzalez
Alex Kim: I can own SIG/CAIQ infra + auth sections. Quick facts: hosted API default log retention = 30d; KV cache ephemeral per session unless enabled; Dedicated/Private available if they insist on no hosted retention. Will draft concise answers and an evidence pack.
Alex Kim: Draft snippet for SIG 'data retention' answer:
```json
{
  "default_log_retention_days": 30,
  "poc_exceptions": "can be reduced to 0 on customer request for POC",
  "deletion_workflow": "deletion executed within 24h of verified request; audit stamp produced"
}```
Maria Gonzalez: We'll send our standard DPA + 2021 SCC addendum. Acme asked for an explicit 'delete derivatives' clause — legal prefers: 'we will delete customer data and customer-provided outputs derived from that data on request.' Need Alex to confirm how we treat embeddings/derived artifacts.
Jonathan Park: Security can assemble CAIQ + evidence bundle (network diagram, MFA screenshots, control owners). For DSARs during POC: flow issues a deletion token + we provide an audit trail (who requested, what was deleted, timestamp). We can also provide a hash-based proof-of-deletion entry. Timeline: CAIQ + evidence ~48h, DPA countersign depends on their legal (3-5 business days).
SecBot: Automated: control-docs export job queued (ticket KR-458). ETA 48h.
Emily Chen: On POC terms/pricing: propose 2-week POC credits + clause: 'data used only for scope of POC; data auto-deleted at POC end unless customer requests extension.' Recommend a one-page success criteria doc to prevent scope creep.
Samira Patel: Next steps: Alex updates SIG answers and confirms embeddings persistence for hosted POC. Maria to send DPA + SCC template to Acme legal. Jonathan to assemble CAIQ + deletion proof runbook. Emily and I will draft POC terms (scope, credits, auto-delete). Any blockers?
Alex Kim: Confirming: embeddings are ephemeral by default on hosted (cache only) and not persisted to long-term stores unless customer opts in or debugging is enabled. In Dedicated/Private they may be persisted to customer-owned storage. For Acme hosted POC we will set persist_embeddings=false and enable ephemeral-only mode. I'll update SIG answers and paste final text by EOD. :thumbsup:
Maria Gonzalez: Preparing DPA + 2021 SCC PDF to email Acme legal. If they push redlines beyond our template (e.g., broader 'derivatives' obligations), escalate to me/legal. :white_check_mark:
Samira Patel: I'll reply to Acme with the timelines and request their SIG/CAIQ upload to this thread. Flag anything urgent.
Jonathan Park: One technical note for the evidence pack: include a short runbook describing the DSAR deletion steps we will execute during the POC (API call, validation, deletion token, audit hash). That will satisfy most infosec reviewers. I can draft it.
Emily Chen: Also include a short POC checklist for Acme: allowed data types, no production customer PII, data retention during debug, and contact points. Helps speed approvals.
Samira Patel: Thanks team — target: SIG + CAIQ artifacts in 48h, DPA sent today. I'll set calendar for kickoff tentative Mon pending countersign.
